body.name: Exact one-collision ATT algorithm
body.construction: \(\mathsf{OneCollisionATT}(P,\eta)\) takes reduced rational encodings of \(\eta\) and the thirty-two cells of \(P\); enumerates exactly \(2\cdot2^3\cdot2=32\) labeled branches \((k_0,s,\sigma)\); builds each ten-variable system \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}\); performs the fixed Collins projection and signed Sturm--Habicht lifting in \(\mathrm{def:observable-sign-certificate}\); and projects each retained cell through \(\tau(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,y);P)\). The joint image is returned as a quantifier-free Boolean combination of integer-polynomial sign conditions in \((\tau_3,\tau_4)\). Each marginal is returned as an ordered finite union of closed intervals and isolated points whose endpoints have a square-free integer polynomial, rational isolating interval, and Thom sign sequence. Every endpoint carries a reconstructed real-algebraic \(\psi\) and its \((k_0,s,\sigma)\) label; every discarded branch carries an exact sign or polynomial infeasibility certificate.
